title: Script Nextbot ESP Infinite Sprint Safe Zone Teleport Fly
features:
[+] Nextbot ESP - Highlights all chasing nextbots through walls showing distance and speed clearly
[+] Infinite Sprint - Your stamina never depletes allowing unlimited running from all pursuers
[+] Safe Zone Teleport - Warp directly to the nearest safe area whenever danger approaches fast
[+] Fly Mode - Soar above the map to completely avoid all ground-level nextbot threats
[+] Speed Boost - Move at extreme velocity to outrun every nextbot during intense chase sequences
[+] No Clip - Phase through walls and obstacles to escape traps and cornered situations instantly
[+] Infinite Health - Take zero damage from all nextbot contact keeping you alive always
[+] Player ESP - Reveals all teammates through walls showing their position and health status
[+] Teleport - Warp to any map location or teammate instantly with a single activation
[+] Auto Revive - Revives downed teammates automatically when you are within proximity range
[+] Anti AFK - Keeps your session active through all rounds without server timeout disconnection
